record.title: Validate aliased assertion inputs before accepting durable state
record.intent: Repair the demonstrated profile-audit constructor bypass and check the same boundary across canonical assertion inputs before native-v1 assessment.
requirements: A programmatic caller must not bypass constructor validity by mutating borrowed assertion evidence or observation collections before a transition. Cover profile audits, planning assertions and task evidence/reviews through shared lifecycle validation.

Reject invalid assertions before accepting a prospective state, returning a writable file plan or committing ledger mutations. Preserve exact historical assertion protocols, contract hashes and evidence; do not reinterpret legacy time or claim evidence truth.

Use the typed domain and existing validation semantics, without Any, unchecked casts, broad Native Image allowances, implicit Git operations, provider bypasses or consumer mutations. Document any remaining ownership or concurrency limits.
acceptance: Retain a completed red witness and regressions proving invalid aliased inputs are rejected, valid assertions survive cold reconstruction and unrelated file bytes/mtimes remain unchanged.
Shared JVM/native behavioral and packaged process parity plus affected remote/client integration pass. Existing historical hash/evidence witnesses retain their meaning before the v1 assessment.
